source: Cross-sections: AS568 (SAE AS568F) standard series 0xx/1xx/2xx/3xx/4xx nominal cross-sections, and common metric ISO 3601 / DIN 3771 cords. Face-seal gland guidance after the Parker O-Ring Handbook (ORD 5700), static face seal design: squeeze roughly 15-30 % (target ~25 %), gland fill not above ~85 %.
